info.name: NKsereke API
info.description:
Complete API documentation for NKsereke delivery platform.

Base URL: https://nksereke.elianaeliohotels.com/api

Authentication: Bearer token (set {{token}} variable after login)

Test credentials:
- Customer: adewale.ogunleye@gmail.com / password
- Rider: taiwo.oduya@rider.com / password

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description: Authentication — register, login, verify email, forgot password

request.description: Register a new customer account. Returns user_id for OTP verification.
Register a new rider account.
Verify email with 6-digit OTP. Returns token on success.

exec: pm.test('Has token', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property('token'); pm.environment.set('token', d.token); });

request.description: Resend verification OTP
Login and get auth token. Saves token to environment variable.

exec: pm.test('Save token', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property('token'); pm.environment.set('token', d.token); pm.environment.set('user_role', d.user.role); });

request.description: Get authenticated user profile
Update user profile
Invalidate token
Get all vendor categories
Get vendors near a location. Use lat/lng for nearby results.
Get vendor detail with fresh rating from reviews table. Includes review_stats inline.

exec: pm.test('Has vendor', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property('vendor'); pm.expect(d.vendor).to.have.property('review_stats'); });

request.description: Get products for a specific vendor. All products include vendor_id field.
Get public reviews for a vendor with stats (average, total, distribution).
Get delivery fee bands and service charge % from admin settings.
Get active ads for the vendor feed with display_frequency
List all saved delivery addresses
Add a new delivery address
List all customer orders
Get full order detail with items, tracking, rider info

exec: pm.test('Has order', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d).to.have.property('order'); pm.expect(d.order).to.have.property('items'); });

request.description: Place an order. payment_method: wallet requires PIN. For card payments use /payments/order first.
Write a review after delivery (status must be 'delivered')

Initiate card payment for an order. Returns authorization_url to open in WebView.
gateway: paystack | flutterwave

exec: pm.test('Has payment URL', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.data).to.have.property('authorization_url'); });

request.description: Generate payment link to fund customer wallet
